==Location Description== A large, lava filled mountain located near Sheridan Village. Black pipes with Yellow Stripes can be seen running throughout it, and Lava can be found throughout. It was formerly damp and calm, and filled with water, only being recently changed by [[Madelis]] and her [[Rift Volcanion|Generator]]. Red mechanical tentacles with eyes can also be found throughout, as a part of the security system.
==Places of Interest== ===Carotos Pinnacle=== The peak of Carotos Mountain, where Kai'ya resides. It is currently inaccessible to the player. ===V.G.C.R.=== The storage space for the toxic waste produced by the generator, the generator itself, and Madelis's private lab.

==Pokémon== A Shadow [[Ponyta]] can be snagged while battling the 1st SEC.
After obtaining the TM for [[Magma Drift]], a [[Cyndaquil]] Egg can be found laying on one of the platforms at the eastern parts of the entrance area. 2 Blast Powder are additionally required to access it. It knows the Egg move Extrasensory.
After acquiring the key from Madelis during the events at Valor Mountain, a [[Ralts]] can be acquired in the V.G.C.R. at the cost of 3 Cell batteries, 1 Pokeball and 1 Metal Powder. It will know the Egg move Shadow Sneak.
